title: Ruthless Bar Salts Pineapple Juice On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Pineapple Juice on Ice delivers the vibrant, sun-ripened sweetness of freshly pressed Pineapple, lifted by a crisp wave of cooling menthol. The bold, tropical fruit flavour offers a juicy, tangy-sweet balance, while the icy finish enhances the refreshment factor, making this a bright and invigorating all-day vape. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a consistent and flavour-packed experience. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine absorption, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy tropical fruit profiles with a frosty twist. Ruthless are one of the most influential brands in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have inspired the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to be a favourite among vapers on both sides of the pond who prize high-quality, distinct and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in vape juice.
